_README: Degree Navigator -> CoursePilot requirement-node mapping (Phase 7.4; docs/DATA_MODEL.md section 51).
A DN requirement maps by its EXACT printed heading; a Core goal by its exact bracketed code. Names are never fuzzy-matched.
Built 2026-10-24 from the developer's own DN audit print (kept local, never committed): every heading and goal code below appeared in it.
review_status: pending_review = built, not yet checked by a named reviewer (used, and shown as such); reviewed = checked; unmapped = no one-to-one CoursePilot node (never used).
A mapping decides only WHICH node a DN status belongs to. It never changes a CoursePilot requirement rule.
A goal maps only where DN's goal set is a one-course goal (a choose-1 node); a goal set that is a multi-course requirement's own pool (NS) is left to its requirement row.

requirements.dn_heading: Requirement R2 : Areas of Inquiry: Natural Sciences [NS]
Requirement R3 : Areas of Inquiry: Social [SCL] and Historical [HST] Analysis
Requirement R4 : Areas of Inquiry: Arts and Humanities [AHo], [AHp], [AHq], [AHr]
Requirement R5 : Cognitive Skills and Processes: Writing and Communication [WC], [WCr], [WCd]
Requirement R6 : Cognitive Skills and Processes: Quantitative and Formal Reasoning [QQ], [QR]

goals.reason: NS is requirement R2's own node (CORE_NS, 6 credits / 2 courses). DN's NS goal set only lists the courses counted so far, so 'a course is listed' is not 'NS is met'; R2 carries CORE_NS's status.
CoursePilot encodes Arts and Humanities as ONE node (CORE_AH, choose 2 courses over goals AHo/AHp/AHq/AHr); there is no one-to-one node for a single AH goal. R4 carries the requirement's status.
